name: k6-performance-framework
description: Production-grade k6 TypeScript performance test automation framework for Conduit RealWorld API

scripts.smoke: npm run build && k6 run --out influxdb=http://localhost:8086/k6 dist/smoke/smoke-test.js
scripts.smoke:ci: npm run build && k6 run --out json=reports/smoke-results.json dist/smoke/smoke-test.js
scripts.load: npm run build && k6 run --out influxdb=http://localhost:8086/k6 dist/load/articles-load.js
scripts.stress: npm run build && k6 run --out influxdb=http://localhost:8086/k6 dist/stress/articles-stress.js
scripts.spike: npm run build && k6 run --out influxdb=http://localhost:8086/k6 dist/spike/traffic-spike.js
scripts.soak: npm run build && k6 run --out influxdb=http://localhost:8086/k6 dist/soak/endurance-soak.js
scripts.breakpoint: npm run build && k6 run --out influxdb=http://localhost:8086/k6 dist/breakpoint/breakpoint-test.js
